root_idea.summary: The supplied lexical evidence centers on مَدِينَة, a city or settled urban place, together with its plural forms.
root_idea.development: The evidence records مدينة as a فعيلة noun, its plural مُدُن, and a related expression for making or founding a city; it does not establish a broader abstract root principle.

qac_form_accounting.reason: مَدَآئِن is a broken plural of مدينة and is presented under the singular dictionary citation headword.
Normalized singular nominal citation form for the Quranic forms مدينة and مَدَآئِن.

senses.definition: A city or town; an inhabited urban settlement.
senses.usage_conditions: Used as a common noun and, in some Quranic occurrences, as the proper name al-Madīnah. The supplied plural مَدَآئِن is included under this citation headword.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A skilful guide, in the idiomatic expression “he is the son of her city.”
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A fixed phrase-level Classical Arabic usage; it is not a general independent meaning of مدينة.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Pointer-only cross-reference to the ميد entry.
Idiomatic expression denoting a skilful guide.

cautions: The ordinary Quranic city meaning is directly supported by the Quran-focused lexical evidence; the supplied Lane material is limited to a pointer and a phrase-level idiom.
